bullet: Takeover keeps newer metadata (`F31.takeover-keeps-metadata`), known bug.
script:
Y=$(control-agent-server conversation start --tools none --no-autotitle --title 'QA F31 before B' --no-run --print-id)
B=$(control-agent-server launch --new --name f31-meta --share-conversations-from "$AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN" --print-run)
trap 'control-agent-server stop --run "$B" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
PIDB=$(jq -r .pid "$B/run.json")
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Y" --json '{"title": "QA F31 after B"}' --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$Y" --check title eq 'QA F31 after B'
DEAD_META=$(jq -r .pid "$AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN/run.json")
control-agent-server restart --hard
.venv/bin/python - "$DEAD_META" <<'PYZOMBIE'
import sys
import psutil
try:
    status = psutil.Process(int(sys.argv[1])).status()
except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
    status = "gone"
print("prior_owner_status=" + status)
assert status in ("zombie", "dead", "gone"), status
PYZOMBIE
until control-agent-server state cat owner_lease.json --conversation "$Y" --check expires_at lt "$(date +%s)" >/dev/null; do
  sleep 1
done
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Y/events/count" --run "$B" --expect 200
control-agent-server state cat owner_lease.json --conversation "$Y" --check owner_pid eq "$PIDB" --check generation eq 2
control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$Y" --check title eq 'QA F31 after B'  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Y" --run "$B" --check title eq 'QA F31 after B' --save F31.takeover-keeps-metadata/get-after-takeover  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$Y" --check title eq 'QA F31 after B'
